items.title: Do AI’s mathematical advances put PKI under threat?
items.summary: Warnings by a leading cryptographer that industry-wide public-key cryptography could fail because of advances in AI has sparked a debate in the security community. In a series of post on X, Johns Hopkins cryptographer Matthew Green warned that existing public-key cryptography systems were at risk because machines have begun outperforming humans in their ability to address some mathematical problems. “I think there is a 1% chance we live in Minicrypt, and a 15% chance we functionally lose confidence in our existing public-key encryption algorithms,” Green wrote last month. items.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
items.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

items.title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
items.summary: The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.

items.title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Cite Third-Party Incidents Amid Data Leak
items.summary: The companies point to third-party providers after the N0n extortion group leaked data allegedly tied to their customers.
